AgentSession request boundary [retained parts and service references]
|
|-- Agent [retained; SDK-created]
|   |-- prepareRequest [installed by _installAgentRequestProjection()]
|   |   |-- -> SessionManager.buildSessionProjection(): canonical messages
|   |   `-- Virtual selection + branch routing -> ModelRuntime.resolveModel()
|   |       `-- Physical request model may differ from retained selection
|   |-- SDK-installed request callbacks [sdk.ts]
|   |   |-- transformContext -> ExtensionRunner.emitContext()
|   |   |-- convertToLlm -> provider messages; optional image filtering
|   |   `-- streamFunction -> ModelRuntime.streamSimple(model, context, options)
|   |       |-- Settings -> transport/retry/timeout options
|   |       `-- Runner hooks -> headers/payload; response/stream observation
|   `-- beforeToolCall / afterToolCall [installed by session]
|       `-- -> Runner tool_call / tool_result; normalize result images
|
|-- ExtensionRunner [created and bound by _buildRuntime()]
|   |-- Retains loader-supplied extensions + shared ExtensionRuntime
|   `-- Session bindings, host bindings, hook dispatch, stale-context guard
|-- Tool machinery [session-held maps and optional nested-call runner]
|   |-- _toolDefinitions / _toolRegistry / prompt metadata / selection state
|   |-- _refreshToolRegistry() -> wraps definitions using ExtensionRunner
|   `-- Messages declare visibility; Agent context.tools holds execution
|
`-- Service references [infrastructure held by AgentSessionServices]
    |-- ResourceLoader -> supplies extensions, skills, templates
    |-- SettingsManager -> runtime configuration
    `-- ModelRuntime [also captured by SDK callbacks]
        |-- pi-ai Models instance: providers + model storage
        |-- RuntimeCredentials -> supplied credentials or default AuthStorage
        `-- resolveModel()/streamSimple() -> routed, authenticated request
